project.name: chitfund-platform
project.description: Aggregator build for the chit fund services. `mvn clean package` from this directory builds every module in one pass. This POM is deliberately not the Maven parent of the modules: each keeps its own spring-boot-starter-parent (all three target Java 17), so each can also be built and deployed on its own from its own directory. The admin module's React UI is built by its Dockerfile (npm), not by Maven.
